settings.editor: A new AC installation is not only for brand-new homes. Many homeowners and business owners install when their current setup does not deliver the comfort, efficiency, or coverage they need.

settings.description_text: A newly built home or commercial space that needs a dependable cooling system from day one.
A room addition, garage, office, or renovated area that needs reliable, comfortable cooling.
A current system that is aging, inefficient, or no longer keeping up with your comfort needs.

settings.editor: Across Central Louisiana, air conditioners work hard through heat and heavy humidity. A thoughtful, properly sized installation helps you avoid comfort issues, energy waste, and unnecessary strain from the very beginning.

settings.title: A Plan Built Around Your Space
Plan Your AC Installation Around The Space You Need To Cool

settings.editor: Installation is about more than connecting equipment. It starts with understanding the space you want to cool and designing a system for its size, layout, airflow, and humidity demands. Poor sizing or the wrong system type leads to hot spots, high energy use, and excess humidity.

settings.title_text: Match The System To The Space
settings.description_text: Square footage, ceiling height, insulation, windows, sun exposure, and room usage all shape the right system size, so it is engineered for the space, not guessed.
Some installs connect to existing ducts; others need modifications or a ductless solution. Checking airflow early prevents equipment that cannot perform.
Central AC for whole-home cooling or a ductless mini-split for additions, garages, and offices. We explain the options so you can choose with confidence.
Cooling is only part of the job. A properly planned install supports humidity control so the space feels comfortable, not cold and sticky.
When equipment, ductwork, airflow, and sizing are matched from the start, your AC runs more efficiently through the long cooling season.

settings.title: Frequently Asked Questions About AC Installation

tabs.tab_title: How do I know what size AC system I need?
tabs.tab_content: The right size depends on more than square footage. Your layout, insulation, windows, ceiling height, ductwork, sun exposure, and humidity concerns all affect sizing. A professional evaluation ensures your new AC is not too large or too small for your space.

tabs.tab_title: Is AC installation different from AC replacement?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Replacement usually means removing an old system and installing a new one in its place. Installation may involve adding cooling to a new home, business, addition, or space that did not previously have a proper system. Both require proper sizing and professional installation.

tabs.tab_title: Can a new AC system help with humidity?
tabs.tab_content: Yes, when properly selected and installed. In Central Louisiana, humidity control is a major part of indoor comfort. A correctly sized AC helps remove moisture more effectively while cooling your home or business.

tabs.tab_title: How long does AC installation usually take?
tabs.tab_content: Many standard installations are completed in a day, but timing depends on the property, system type, ductwork needs, equipment access, and complexity. We explain the expected timeline during your consultation.

tabs.tab_title: Can I finance a new AC installation?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Magnolia Air offers financing options to help make installation more manageable. During your consultation we can discuss available options so you can choose a system that fits your comfort needs and budget.
